## Part one

::: {.definition}
<span id="def-widget" class="anchor"></span>[**Definition [1.1.1]{.num data-note="t/alpha/first"} (Widget)**]{.theorem-title} A *widget* is a thing with
$$ w = 1. $$
:::

::: {.theorem}
<span id="thm-widget" class="anchor"></span>[**Theorem [1.1.1]{.num data-note="t/alpha/first"} (Widget theorem)**]{.theorem-title} Every widget is a widget.
:::

::: {.proof}
1. Trivial.

2. Done.
:::

[Exercise 3]{.problem-title}[DEMO 1.10 Basics exercises]{.problem-source}[Code]{.code-badge}

Write `double(x)` that returns twice `x`.

::: {.coding-starter}
```python
def double(x):
    """Return 2 * x."""
    ...
```
:::

::: {.coding-tests}
```python
def test_small():
    assert double(2) == 4


def test_zero():
    assert double(0) == 0
```
:::
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="simple" title="Draft solution (not yet reviewed)"}
```{.python}
def double(x):
    """Return 2 * x."""
    return 2 * x
```

1. Multiply by two.
:::
